slides.title: ORBITAL INSERTION ACHIEVED
slides.text: The NPC Masr transfer vehicle enters Martian orbit! High-resolution orbital sensors scan candidate coordinates across Chryse Planitia and adjacent crater basins for safe surface touchdowns.

slides.title: VIKING RECON & ICE DETECTION
slides.text: Robotics Specialist Nour locates the Viking lander site to benchmark subsurface ice radar readings. Initial telemetry indicates promising regolith stability and accessible water ice deposits.

slides.title: ESTABLISH THE SETTLEMENT
slides.text: Commander Rodaina initiates descent protocol: 'MAVEN 1 paved the path. Today, we anchor humanity's first sustainable outpost on the Red Planet!' Deploy the habitat, activate MOXIE, and secure vital resources.
